data.name: Feral Mutagen
data.description: Whenever the mutation warrior imbibes a mutagen, he gains two claw attacks and a bite attack. These are primary attacks and are made using the mutation warrior's full base attack bonus. The claw attacks deal 1d6 points of damage (1d4 if the mutation warrior is Small) and the bite attack deals 1d8 points of damage (1d6 if the mutation warrior is Small). While the mutagen is in effect, the mutation warrior gains a +2 competence bonus on Intimidate skill checks.
